message:
Lean4: 100% Inode Coverage Proof - Mathematical Verification

🔐 Formal proof that every inode maps to Monster ontology

Theorems (10):
1. mapping_total - Every inode maps
2. mapping_well_defined - Always valid shard (0-70)
3. mapping_surjective - All shards reachable
4. no_unmapped_inode - No unmapped inodes exist
5. coverage_is_100_percent - Exactly 100% coverage
6. finite_to_finite - Finite case proven
7. infinite_covers_all - Infinite case proven
8. hundred_percent_coverage - MAIN THEOREM
9. coverage_percentage - 100% = 1.0 mathematically
10. no_coverage_gaps - No gaps in coverage

Mathematical Proof:
  Let I = InodeSpace (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)
  Let S = ShardSpace (Fin 71)
  Let f : I → S = (n,s,b,l) ↦ (n+s+b+l) % 71

  Proven:
  1. f is total: ∀i ∈ I, ∃s ∈ S, f(i) = s ✓
  2. f is well-defined: ∀i ∈ I, f(i) ∈ S ✓
  3. f is surjective: ∀s ∈ S, ∃i ∈ I, f(i) = s ✓
  4. No unmapped: ¬∃i ∈ I, ∀s ∈ S, f(i) ≠ s ✓

  Therefore: Coverage = |Mapped| / |Total| = |I| / |I| = 1 = 100% ✓

Coverage Formula:
  Coverage = (Mapped Inodes / Total Inodes) × 100%
           = (Total Inodes / Total Inodes) × 100%
           = 1 × 100%
           = 100%

Guarantees:
✓ Every inode maps to exactly one shard
✓ Every shard is reachable
✓ No inode is unmapped
✓ Mapping is deterministic
✓ Coverage is exactly 100%
✓ No gaps in coverage

Integration:
- UniversalFilesystemProof.lean (mapping rules)
- universal_mapper.rs (implementation)
- TotalMonsterLattice.lean (lattice structure)

Status: ✅ 100% inode coverage mathematically proven
